reviewed.cause_note: The guard changes from `<` to `<=` TITLE_LENGTH, as the spec asks. Any title of 42 characters or fewer is now returned unchanged, and longer ones are still cut to 42 including the ellipsis. Nothing depends on the test's specific inputs, and no other place in src uses the same truncation pattern.
